verdict.rationale: The DGX B300 documents headless, programmatic operation through its BMC: Redfish and IPMI management, remote KVM and remote storage. It also runs a standard Linux OS (DGX OS 7 on Ubuntu 24.04, with RHEL and Rocky support), so it can be automated without a local console. Nothing shows CI-specific integration, such as runner setup or pipeline docs, for the B300 itself; the Kubernetes/Helm mention is for NIM software, not the hardware. missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline integration, automation guides for the B300 system, hands-on or independent corroboration of headless automated use.
